hook: What happens when the driest desert on Earth suddenly floods with record rainfall?

sections.voiceover: What happens when the driest desert on Earth suddenly floods with record rainfall?
b_roll: Satellite map of Atacama Desert in Chile

sections.voiceover: AP News reports that a super El Niño transformed Chile's Atacama Desert, but can flowers grow? Can a super El Niño's record rainfall bring life to Chile's Atacama Desert?
However, this massive flowering event marks the most extensive one since 1997.
The Los Angeles Times documented 6,560 square miles bursting open. More than 200 plant species carpeted the sand. Spring blooms will persist until November.
b_roll: Vibrant fields of wildflowers across the desert floor

sections.voiceover: Those 6,560 square miles remain covered in wildflowers until November.
b_roll: Wide shot of blooming Atacama Desert landscape
